name: Mariehamn (Åland)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of Mariehamn: a blue shield with a gold anchor beneath three green linden trees.
history: The arms, by Nils Byman, were confirmed in 1951; the town flies them on a white flag. No adoption date for the flag has been published.

features.role: arms of Mariehamn with anchor and linden trees
features.symbolism: the maritime economy and the 'town of a thousand lindens'
